title: Can It Drive There: Slope and Roughness From a Height Map, Judged Against What This Vehicle's Motors, Tyres and Wheels Can Do

artifact.note: a height grid, the slope and the roughness of each cell from a plane fitted to its 3 by 3 neighbourhood, the limits of a vehicle (the smallest of what its motors can climb, what its tyres grip and where it tips, and the step its wheels can take), and a traversability layer of costs that rises as either limit is approached and is lethal beyond it
